_meta.description: SightQuick is free to download and your first target is free. Print credits are in-app purchases: 1 for $1.99, 5 for $8.99 or 20 for $29.99. No subscription.
a-range-target-from.5f9711: A range target from a partner range
a-zeroing-target-any.770275: A zeroing target, any paper size
about-1-50-a.55120a: About $1.50 a target, for a season of zeroing or a safe full of rifles.
can-my-family-share.8aba30: Can my family share my credits?
credits-pay-for-printing.7d0a04: Credits pay for printing a new target. Scanning is always free.
credits-used-by-each.3625d9: Credits used by each kind of target, as of September 2026.
free-to-download-and.c99231: Free to download, and your first target is free. After that you pay per target, with print credits sold as in-app purchases. No subscription.
free-with-the-download.fd9c6d: Free with the download, so you can zero once before you pay anything.
no-credits-are-consumable.c7be91: No. Credits are consumable in-app purchases, which Family Sharing doesn't cover.
no-unused-credits-stay.3b336d: No. Unused credits stay on your iPhone until you print with them.
one-credit-prints-one.c12f25: One credit prints one uniquely coded target, good for a complete zeroing session you can re-photograph as you dial in.
one-target-for-one.5db432: One target, for one rifle or one range trip.
scanning-a-target-again.ea8ab6: Scanning a target again as you dial in
sightquick-is-free-to.594132: SightQuick is free to download, and your first target is free. After that, each target uses a print credit, sold as an in-app purchase in packs of 1, 5 or 20. A credit covers one complete zeroing session you can re-photograph as you dial in. No subscription, no ads.
us-prices-shown-the.ff77b0: US prices shown; the App Store shows yours. Credits are consumable in-app purchases: no subscription, no ads.
what-happens-to-my.a64132: What happens to my credits if I delete the app?
your-balance-is-kept.196d1a: Your balance is kept in your iPhone's keychain, so deleting and reinstalling SightQuick doesn't lose it or give out a second free target.
